text:
Alex: Heads-up: syncing on lane economics & scope for the region-mesh cutover. Want to lock acceptance criteria for customer onramps. TL;DR: we need per-lane SLO, fallback economics, and a migration play.
Sapna: Can you call out which customers are blocking? we should prioritize the ones with committed capacity.
Cheng: @Alex sending the list — main ones: Acme (>2TB), FinchCo (high latency sensitivity), HealthX (compliance).
Alex: Thanks. For acceptance: (1) canary in single region under 5% error budget; (2) graceful fallback within 200ms for 95% of requests; (3) unit cost delta < 20% vs hosted baseline. Thoughts?
Olivia: 200ms for fallback is tight for large models; can we do 300ms and add a compensating SLA for throughput?
Drew: If we relax to 300ms we need to adjust batch sizes; infra impact estimate: +1.2k GPU-hours/week in peak.
Sapna: :thinking_face: Is that cost for onramp lanes only or global?
Cheng: Onramp lanes only. If we use prefix caching for the thermal workloads we can shave ~30% off.
Alex: Proposal: keep 200ms for FinchCo/HealthX, 300ms for others; map customers to lane tiers. Need product OK and finance signoff.
Olivia: Agree. Also need routing policy snippet for policy-as-code. Sample config I sketched:
```yaml
lane: finch
latency_slo_ms: 200
fallback_variant: small-quantized-v2
cost_threshold_pct: 20
canary_percent: 1
```
Drew: Add autoscale headroom param and KV-cache hint. Example: `autoscale_headroom: 25`
infra-bot: DEPLOYMENT_CHECK: Canary manifest for `lane-fin` passed basic checks in staging.
Alex: Next steps: Sapna/Olivia — finalize lane mapping doc by Fri. Cheng/Drew — cost model + perf run by EOD Thu. I'll consolidate ask to sales for committed customers list. :thumbsup: 
Sapna: On it. Will ping sales later today.
Olivia: I'll draft the acceptance checklist in GH issue and link here.
Cheng: I'll drop perf numbers once the run finishes (should be ~6 hours).
Drew: If anyone wants to tweak batcher params for the run, DM me now.
Alex: If we get >2 customers in Tier A we'll propose a reserved pool. Otherwise use routing variants + fallback. Flagging as Q3 scope.
Olivia: Noted — adding to roadmap board. @Alex can you add the resource estimate so PMO sees it?
Alex: Added estimate to the doc. Link: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/lanes#lane-econ (permissions: product-team).
Sapna: :party-parrot: great sync. Quick question — do we need legal signoff for HealthX due to data residency?
Cheng: Yes. HealthX requires Private deploy option and KMS. That's a separate dependency (eng-legal + security).
Alex: I'll loop in @maria-legal after we have the lane map. End.
